# stripe_terminal_configuration (Data Source)

How Stripe Terminal readers behave: tipping, splash screens, reboot window and Wi-Fi. `terraform destroy` deletes the configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "stripe_terminal_configuration" "store" {
  id = stripe_terminal_configuration.store.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the object.

### Read-Only

- `bbpos_wisepad3` (Attributes) An object containing device type specific settings for BBPOS WisePad 3 readers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--bbpos_wisepad3))
- `bbpos_wisepos_e` (Attributes) An object containing device type specific settings for BBPOS WisePOS E readers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--bbpos_wisepos_e))
- `cellular` (Attributes) Configuration for cellular connectivity. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cellular))
- `is_account_default` (Boolean) Whether this Configuration is the default for your account
- `livemode` (Boolean) If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.
- `name` (String) Name of the configuration
- `offline` (Attributes) Configurations for collecting transactions offline. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--offline))
- `reboot_window` (Attributes) Reboot time settings for readers. that support customized reboot time configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--reboot_window))
- `stripe_s700` (Attributes) An object containing device type specific settings for Stripe S700 readers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--stripe_s700))
- `stripe_s710` (Attributes) An object containing device type specific settings for Stripe S710 readers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--stripe_s710))
- `tipping` (Attributes) Tipping configurations for readers that support on-reader tips. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tipping))
- `verifone_m425` (Attributes) An object containing device type specific settings for Verifone M425 readers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--verifone_m425))
- `verifone_p400` (Attributes) An object containing device type specific settings for Verifone P400 readers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--verifone_p400))
- `verifone_p630` (Attributes) An object containing device type specific settings for Verifone P630 readers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--verifone_p630))
- `verifone_ux700` (Attributes) An object containing device type specific settings for Verifone UX700 readers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--verifone_ux700))
- `verifone_v660p` (Attributes) An object containing device type specific settings for Verifone V660p readers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--verifone_v660p))
- `wifi` (Attributes) Configurations for connecting to a WiFi network. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--wifi))

<a id="nestedatt--wifi"></a>
### Nested Schema for `wifi`

Read-Only:

- `enterprise_eap_peap` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--wifi--enterprise_eap_peap))
- `enterprise_eap_tls` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--wifi--enterprise_eap_tls))
- `personal_psk` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--wifi--personal_psk))
- `type` (String) Security type of the WiFi network. The hash with the corresponding name contains the credentials for this security type. Possible values: `enterprise_eap_peap`, `enterprise_eap_tls`, `personal_psk`.

<a id="nestedatt--wifi--enterprise_eap_peap"></a>
### Nested Schema for `wifi.enterprise_eap_peap`

Read-Only:

- `ca_certificate_file` (String) A File ID representing a PEM file containing the server certificate
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password for connecting to the WiFi network
- `ssid` (String) Name of the WiFi network
- `username` (String) Username for connecting to the WiFi network


<a id="nestedatt--wifi--enterprise_eap_tls"></a>
### Nested Schema for `wifi.enterprise_eap_tls`

Read-Only:

- `ca_certificate_file` (String) A File ID representing a PEM file containing the server certificate
- `client_certificate_file` (String) A File ID representing a PEM file containing the client certificate
- `private_key_file` (String) A File ID representing a PEM file containing the client RSA private key
- `private_key_file_password` (String, Sensitive) Password for the private key file
- `ssid` (String) Name of the WiFi network


<a id="nestedatt--wifi--personal_psk"></a>
### Nested Schema for `wifi.personal_psk`

Read-Only:

- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password for connecting to the WiFi network
- `ssid` (String) Name of the WiFi network
